run_env_examination: run a gym environment rollout with a policy and save trajectories to an HDF5 file
run_random_policy: run a random policy rollout in a gym environment for a specified number of episodes
run_policy_evaluation: run a pickled policy in evaluation mode against a gym environment and log results
create_rand_policy: create a random policy class that samples actions from a gym environment action space
plot_rollout_paths: plot 2D visualizations of individual rollout paths from a gym environment
